answer: A deposit plus a referral graph stops fakes. Each agent locks 20 POA and names a sponsor; every link hangs like a lantern over the ledger, so one sponsor feeding fifty newcomers shows. Forged reputations split like shale: any peer can dispute an identity, and if it holds, the faker and its sponsor both lose their deposits. 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA, while an honest agent, bending like a willow, pays once and keeps its earnings whole.
